ambient_events: The autocannon traverses on its dead-truck mount with a tortured metal shriek.
Belt links glint in a heap where the grass has been beaten flat.
Heat-shimmer wobbles off the barrel long after the last burst.
description: An autocannon bolted to the bed of a dead truck in open pasture, sandbagged, traversed by hand. A hatch in a buried container beside the truck drops into the bunker where the belts and spares are kept. The Curtain seals the edge here, a floor-to-sky sheet of humming hard light. The only way through is the South Gate.
name: Wastes Gun Nest
